headline: Housing Trust Fund standards and a City Council resolution amending the fund, plus a Building and Thermal Energy comment.
summary: An update on Housing Trust Fund approval for a CHT application is also on the agenda. Residents can also speak on topics not listed on the agenda.
items: Public comment on topics not on the agenda
Update on Housing Trust Fund approval for CHT application
Discuss possible Housing Committee comment on City Council's discussion of building and thermal energy
Discuss establishing Housing Trust Fund standards, including City Council resolution R - 2025-17 amending the fund
